name: Metal Doll Crystal Moth
source:
In the heart of the crumbling Seloventra Empire, Jacie, an animate crystal carved into the shape of a beautiful young woman, is awoken from a seven-year stint in stasis. 

Her attendant, Suzie, one of the winged doll-like F.A.E.R.I.E. servants, informs her of the Empire's distress, and how the Empress herself has summoned Jacie to brief her personally for a secret mission of paramount importance with earth-shaking consequences...

[From [url=https://kyousystem.itch.io/metal-doll-crystal-moth-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在摇摇欲坠的塞洛文特拉帝国的中心，杰西，一颗被雕刻成美丽年轻女子形状的生命水晶，从七年的停滞状态中苏醒。

她的侍从苏西 (Suzie) 是长着翅膀的玩偶F.A.E.R.I.E. 之一。仆人，告诉她帝国的困境，以及女皇如何亲自召唤杰西，亲自向她通报一项极其重要的秘密任务，其后果将是翻天覆地的……

[来自[url=https://kyousystem.itch.io/metal-doll-crystal-moth-demo]itch.io[/url]]
